description: BATCHES: run any Logimu endpoint over a whole list in one job and come back for the results - the same batch API as REST /v1/batches (see https://api.logimu.com/docs#batch). action=estimate prices a list before anything is billed (free); action=create makes a named, re-runnable batch (add start=true to launch its first run at once); action=run launches a run of an existing batch; action=status reports a batch (runs, line stats) or, with run_id, one run's progress (rows done, credits so far, queue position); action=results returns completed result rows of a run, mid-run too (limit / offset to page; jsonl_url and csv_url give the full download); action=list lists the account's batches; action=schedule repeats a batch every 12 hours / daily / weekly / monthly (credit_ceiling, webhook_url); action=delete removes a batch. USE WHEN the user has more than a handful of ASINs, barcodes, search terms, seller ids, brands or seeds to run, wants a daily/weekly refresh, or wants a CSV. Kinds: product (asins or gtins - or source=tracked for the ASINs this account tracks, typically with include [history_only] at 0.05 a row), search (terms, live SERP), seller / brand / category / keywords (paid plans), and every other endpoint as its own kind (shopping, warehouse_search, bestsellers, offers, deals, seller_products, seller_brands, seller_network, brand_sellers, brand_network, keywords_compare, categories, category_search, brands_top, brands_movers, sellers_top, sellers_movers, categories_top) with the endpoint's query parameters in params. Each row bills what the endpoint bills; failed, not-found and duplicate rows are never billed; runs are serialized per marketplace. COST estimate / status / results / list are free; create + run queue billable rows (the estimate is the ceiling). API key required (keyed lanes).

action.description: What to do (see the tool description).

asins.description: product batches: the ASINs (or Walmart item ids).

at_hour_utc.description: schedule, 12h and daily only: the UTC hour it fires at (12h: this hour and 12 hours later). Default: 12h = the current UTC hour, daily = 0. Kept when the same cadence is saved again without it.

batch_id.description: For run / status / results / schedule / delete.

category_ids.description: category / categories batches (ids, or root); deals batches (deals department ids, or all for the whole deals page).

country.description: estimate / create: us, uk, de, ca, au, fr, it, es, jp, mx, br, walmart (search batches Amazon only).

credit_ceiling.description: schedule: a firing whose fresh estimate exceeds this does not run (email instead); default 2x the estimate.

gtins.description: product batches: barcodes instead of ASINs.

include.description: Extras: history (seller / brand / category / keywords), reviews, used, offer_history, bsr_history, history_only (product), blocks (search).

kind.description: estimate / create: product (default), search, seller, brand, category, keywords, or any endpoint kind named in the description.

limit.description: results: rows to return (page with offset; the download URLs carry everything).

mode.description: product / seller batches: cache = warehouse only, live = scrape every row, auto = warehouse when fresh enough (required on create for product batches).

pages.description: search batches: pages per term (1-3); ranked-list batches: pages of 25 rows (1-40).

params.description: endpoint kinds: the endpoint's query parameters, fixed for every row.

run_id.description: For status (one run's progress) and results.

schedule.description: schedule: how often the batch re-runs (none stops the schedule). 12h fires twice a day, at at_hour_utc and 12 hours later; daily once a day at at_hour_utc (default midnight UTC); weekly on Monday and monthly on the 1st, 00:00 UTC.

source.description: product batches: tracked = the ASINs this account tracks on the marketplace instead of a list.

start.description: create: also launch the first run at once.

terms.description: search / shopping / warehouse_search / category_search batches: the queries.

webhook_url.description: schedule: POSTed on run completion / pause, HMAC-SHA256 signed; the secret is returned once.

name: batch
